Prof. Dr. Test Doctor

Interventional Radiology Specialist

Prof. Dr. Test Doctor is a medical doctor with experience in interventional radiology. He currently practices at Example City Hospital.

Education and Career Background

- After graduating from Example University Faculty of Medicine in 1997, he began working as an emergency physician at Sample State Hospital that same year.

- Between 1998 and 2002, he completed his residency in radiology at Example University Hospital.

- Between 2004 and 2016, he worked as a specialist in interventional radiology at Alpha Hospital, Beta Hospital, and Gamma Hospital, respectively.

- Between 2017 and 2020, he served as an Assistant Professor at Example University Istanbul Hospital and was awarded the title of Associate Professor in 2020.

- He joined the Interventional Radiology Unit at Example City Hospital in 2024 and was awarded the title of Professor in 2026.

- He holds a 1st Dan rank in Aikido and a Level 1 coaching certificate.

- He holds a Certificate of Practice and Competence in Medical Hypnosis, awarded through a program organized by Example University in accordance with the national curriculum.

-   Example Medical Chamber
